scope: Native EX/CC sparse differentiation/integration and literal-zero evaluation; dense/sparse ZZ/QQ fraction-free reductions including DomainMatrix AUTO FF/CD; exact algebraic zero-times-zoo correction in radsimp

source_identity.scope: Code, tests, audit fixtures, package configuration and native binary; documentation excluded

precision_corrections: Grouped derivative spec(x,m) is evaluated once at orderm; separate specs remain sequential. Old repeated diff1 grouping could change float bits.
Multivariate inexact calculus now uses Dom at the selected precisionp instead of EX at display precisionp-prime. The private exact-input probe fixes32 of100 contexts, including four order1 calls.
Orders/factorials use checked conversions and BigInt factors; actual coefficient cancellation precedes the public coordinate bound. No32-bit execution is claimed.
remaining_gaps: No global mathematical parity certified. Complete documentation replay on576a still has278 differing objects requiring review.
Sparse evaluation at nonzero values retains established dense/Horner paths. Other nonported dense algorithms can still be expensive at large coordinates.
Coordinates aboveu32 and public calculus orders outsidei64 remain representation/API limits. Proven zero results are preserved before capacity refusal; actual32-bit execution is unvalidated.
The public EX constructor still loses interior/trailing Float0 payloads; a separate native construction/view/pickle port is in progress.

Custom/inexact/other-domain fraction-free matrix routes, aliases/invalid storage and the one-row sparse shallow-copy branch keep their original complete paths. The Python ordering adapter performs only stock key-set protocol operations, with Rust checking memberships.

radsimp corrects the audited concrete algebraic zero-times-zoo product using exact structural/minimal-polynomial proof. It does not certify all nonfinite arithmetic or all undecidable zero expressions.
Symbolic derivative orders and native log_to_atan are separate unintegrated work, absent from this release.

The native literal-zero kernel does not yet accelerate public univariate EX eval(0): its Python adapter still reconstructs as_expr in this release. The paired control shows no gain; the public routing/payload fix is separate pending work.
